preamble.summary: Isaiah 29 is the WOE-TO-ARIEL (Jerusalem) oracle. Verses 13–14 are cited at Matthew 15:8–9 / Mark 7:6–7 (Jesus' rebuke of Pharisaic-tradition: 'this people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me'). Verse 14 is also cited at 1 Corinthians 1:19 ('I will destroy the wisdom of the wise').
preamble.notable_variants: 29:13 'this people honors me with their lips' → Matthew 15:8–9 / Mark 7:6–7 verbatim; 29:14 'I will destroy the wisdom of the wise' → 1 Corinthians 1:19 verbatim-LXX; 29:18 'the deaf shall hear' → Matthew 11:5 Messianic-fulfillment.

variant_notes: 'Ah, Ariel, Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts run their round' tracks MT. ARIEL — Jerusalem-as-altar-hearth (cf. Ezek 43:15–16). The-city-where-David-encamped.
'Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be moaning and lamentation, and she shall be to me like an Ariel' tracks MT.
'And I will encamp against you all around, and will besiege you with towers and I will raise siegeworks against you' tracks MT.

'And you will be brought low; from the earth you shall speak, and from the dust your speech will be bowed down; your voice shall come from the ground like the voice of a ghost, and from the dust your speech shall whisper' tracks MT. WHISPER-FROM-DUST — necromantic-imagery.
'But the multitude of your foreign foes shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the ruthless like passing chaff. And in an instant, suddenly' tracks MT.
'You will be visited by the LORD of hosts with thunder and with earthquake and great noise, with whirlwind and tempest, and the flame of a devouring fire' tracks MT.
'And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, all that fight against her and her stronghold and distress her, shall be like a dream, a vision of the night' tracks MT.

'As when a hungry man dreams he is eating and awakes with his hunger not satisfied, or as when a thirsty man dreams he is drinking and awakes faint, with his thirst not quenched, so shall the multitude of all the nations be that fight against Mount Zion' tracks MT.
'Astonish yourselves and be astonished; blind yourselves and be blind! Be drunk, but not with wine; stagger, but not with strong drink!' tracks MT.

'For the LORD has poured out upon you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes (the prophets), and covered your heads (the seers)' tracks MT. SPIRIT-OF-DEEP-SLEEP. Romans 11:8 ('God gave them a spirit of stupor') directly-cites this-vocabulary.

'And the vision of all this has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed. When men give it to one who can read, saying: Read this, he says: I cannot, for it is sealed' tracks MT. SEALED-BOOK. Revelation 5:1–9 (the-scroll-with-seven-seals only-the-Lamb can-open) Christologically-extends — Christ-alone-opens-the-sealed-prophetic-vision.
'And when they give the book to one who cannot read, saying: Read this, he says: I cannot read' tracks MT.

verses.mt_reading: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲדֹנָי יַעַן כִּי נִגַּשׁ הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּפִיו וּבִשְׂפָתָיו כִּבְּדוּנִי וְלִבּוֹ רִחַק מִמֶּנִּי וַתְּהִי יִרְאָתָם אֹתִי מִצְוַת אֲנָשִׁים מְלֻמָּדָה
verses.lxx_reading: ἐγγίζει μοι ὁ λαὸς οὗτος τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτῶν τιμῶσίν με ἡ δὲ καρδία αὐτῶν πόρρω ἀπέχει ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ μάτην δὲ σέβονταί με διδάσκοντες ἐντάλματα ἀνθρώπων καὶ διδασκαλίας
verses.mt_rendering: And the Lord said: Because this people draw near with their mouth and honor me with their lips, while their hearts are far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment taught by men
verses.variant_rendering: This people draw near to me with their lips and honor me with their lips, but their heart is far from me; and in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men
variant_notes: MATTHEW 15:8–9 / MARK 7:6–7 CITATION. Jesus cites this verse VERBATIM-FROM-LXX in his rebuke of the Pharisees: 'You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, when he said: THIS PEOPLE HONORS ME WITH THEIR LIPS, BUT THEIR HEART IS FAR FROM ME; IN VAIN DO THEY WORSHIP ME, TEACHING AS DOCTRINES THE COMMANDMENTS OF MEN.' Both Matthew 15:8–9 and Mark 7:6–7 cite this LXX-form (with 'in vain' / 'doctrines' which-are-LXX-additions absent-from-MT).

MAJOR LXX-PLUS. The LXX adds 'matēn de sebontai me' ('and in vain do they worship me') — a phrase ABSENT from MT. Jesus' citation includes-this-LXX-plus, demonstrating Jesus-and-the-Gospels' use of-the-LXX as authoritative-Scripture. The verse becomes-the-foundation for-Jesus' critique of-tradition-overriding-Torah.

verses.mt_reading: לָכֵן הִנְנִי יוֹסִף לְהַפְלִיא אֶת־הָעָם־הַזֶּה הַפְלֵא וָפֶלֶא וְאָבְדָה חָכְמַת חֲכָמָיו וּבִינַת נְבֹנָיו תִּסְתַּתָּר
verses.lxx_reading: διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ προσθήσω τοῦ μεταθεῖναι τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον καὶ μεταθήσω αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν κρύψω
verses.mt_rendering: Therefore, behold, I will again do wonderful things with this people, with wonder upon wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the discernment of their discerning men shall be hidden
verses.variant_rendering: Therefore behold, I will proceed to remove this people, and I will remove them, and I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and I will hide the understanding of the prudent
variant_notes: 1 CORINTHIANS 1:19 CITATION. Paul cites this verse at 1 Cor 1:19: 'For it is written: I WILL DESTROY THE WISDOM OF THE WISE, AND THE DISCERNMENT OF THE DISCERNING I WILL THWART (apolō tēn sophian tōn sophōn, kai tēn synesin tōn synetōn athetēsō).' Paul's-wording matches-LXX-Isaiah-29:14 closely. The verse anchors-Paul's-foolishness-of-the-cross argument — divine-wisdom overturning-worldly-wisdom.
'Ah, you who hide deep from the LORD your counsel, whose deeds are in the dark, and who say: Who sees us? Who knows us?' tracks MT.

'You turn things upside down! Shall the potter be regarded as the clay, that the thing made should say of its maker: He did not make me; or the thing formed say of him who formed it: He has no understanding?' tracks MT. POTTER-CLAY analogy. Romans 9:20–21 ('does the thing molded say to its molder: Why have you made me thus? Has the potter no right over the clay?') directly-extends. Jeremiah 18:1–6 develops the same image.

'Is it not yet a very little while until Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be regarded as a forest?' tracks MT. RAPID-RESTORATION. Lebanon-to-fruitful-field reversal.

'In that day the deaf shall hear the words of a book, and out of their gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind shall see' tracks MT. DEAF-HEAR / BLIND-SEE. Matthew 11:4–5 (Jesus' answer to John the Baptist: 'the blind receive their sight … the deaf hear') Christologically-fulfills directly.
'The meek shall obtain fresh joy in the LORD, and the poor among mankind shall exult in the Holy One of Israel' tracks MT. MEEK-OBTAIN-JOY. Beatitude-tradition (Matthew 5:3–5).
'For the ruthless shall come to nothing and the scoffer cease, and all who watch to do evil shall be cut off' tracks MT.
'Who by a word make a man out to be an offender, and lay a snare for him who reproves in the gate, and with an empty plea turn aside him who is in the right' tracks MT.
'Therefore thus says the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: Jacob shall no more be ashamed, no more shall his face grow pale' tracks MT.
'For when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in his midst, they will sanctify my name; they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob and will stand in awe of the God of Israel' tracks MT.
'And those who go astray in spirit will come to understanding, and those who murmur will accept instruction' tracks MT. CLOSES with restoration-of-understanding.
